next.reason: 1985: 'the word ALL is redundant and is used for readability only', so with SRL3.1 ('the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO') ALL ZERO stood wherever ZERO did, a numeric-only literal included. 2023 drops the redundancy statement and §2023:8.3.3.6.3 SR1 a) permits there only 'ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES) without the ALL phrase': ALL ZERO in that position, accepted in 1985, is refused (a case removed), so CHANGED. Kept parts: ALL optional in formats 1-5 (FMT-8.3.3.6.2) with one character when 'other than ALL literal-1' (§2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3); HIGH/LOW-VALUE follow the program collating sequence except in SPECIAL-NAMES (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR8, GR9; §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR6, GR7).
